Product Features

  • Modern design with a vintage look: the bed is upholstered in cotton and linen fabric, the vintage-patterned wooden panels and colorful LED lighting give it a modern vintage look, and the upholstered headboard is filled with high-density foam so you can relax comfortably on the headboard.
  • LED LIGHTING: The LED lighting at the head and foot of the bed adds a modern style to your bedroom, and the remote control allows you to change the different colors and brightness for a comfortable bedtime.
  • Charging dock with USB port: One of the most useful features is the built-in USB socket at the head of the bed, which allows you to charge your mobile phone and tablet before bed.
  • Flexible and spacious storage: The shelf can be used to store mobile phones or tablets. With the support of the gas strut, the space under the bed slats can be used to store large items. The slatted frame can be easily folded up by lifting the fabric strips. A non-woven fabric is attached to the bottom of the bed to keep the dust away.
  • Practicality meets design: Bed skilfully combines elegant design and maximum comfort. The bed has stoppers at the head end that prevent the mattress from slipping. The slatted frames are made of 100% solid wood and metal offer both a high load-bearing capacity and a high level of sleeping comfort.
  • Detailed Information: To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame will be shipped in 2 cartons and these can arrive on different days. If both packages arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.When you move the bed, please lift it instead of dragging it on the floor. Before returning the product, please contact the seller first. Thank you for your understanding.
